_comment: The /vu meters beat-analyzer measured (7dd100b16410f0aec58638db37663d99374753d1) and where the engine takes each (O13, P11; baseline Step 7). patchbay = the REAPER out a3-patchbay.xml fed the analyzer's port from (REAPER's VU outs: 1-20 out n+30, 21-36 out n-10, 51-66 out n); defaultMap = the link of Plan 4's data/engine.json (before Task 24) that fed it in engine mode, now removed. 41-50 are StemDeck's own and not the engine's.
